correctness.rationale: Summing the two-step chip changes gives Lf=0, so connectedness and primitivity force exactly one firing per vertex across the two phases. A nontrivial first-phase shore A supports exactly prod_v c_v(A) first-phase states, where c_v is its number of neighbors across the cut. Division by two counts temporal orbits. Deleted matching edges each affect two cross-degrees and yield the displayed binomial sum by splitting-pair count s, intact-pair count p and unmatched-vertex count t. Under complete-graph cut weights binom(N,a)b^a a^b, central cut sizes have exponential concentration; conditional split indicators give E[S|a]=2kab/[N(N-1)] and exactly E[S(1/a+1/b)|a]=2k/(N-1). Their conditional variance is O(N), so second-order exponential Taylor and the O(1/N) logarithmic replacement deliver a constant uniform in k. I independently enumerated all shores for N=4..9 and reproduced samples of finite counts and uniform scaled errors. Finite enumeration is not the proof of the uniform asymptotic.
